entities.summary: Vladimir Abramovich Neumann, also known as Victor Alexandrovich Berg but more commonly known by his nom de guerre "Nikolsky," was a member of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union and a participant in the 1st National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party.
